# An invoice whose `posted:` block states the transaction from
# a_sale_booked_to_the_receivable_in_two_splits.txt as its posting.
#
# That transaction has two splits on `Assets:Accounts Receivable`. A posting
# has one, the split the invoice's lot holds, and nothing says which of the two
# it would be.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_posting_the_book_holds_is_refused_where_it_cannot_be_the_records.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-POSTED-THROUGH-TWO-SPLITS"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Sales, booked by hand"
		accumulate: true
		posted_txn_guid: "8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e"
